note: The list of media EPIC N owes, and the one place #997 looks up an id, a file name and its alt text. A still has four variants (variants[].suffix). state needs-ui-state means the stack has no UI state to photograph; the release gate counts its files as missing until the state exists and the entry becomes capturable. Store-submission screenshots are not here and are never generated.

stills.name: encryption-01-settings-off
stills.caption: Retained-copy encryption is off by default: one switch and a sentence, no key field.

stills.name: encryption-02-enable-dialog
stills.caption: Turning it on asks one question, who holds the key, and echoes the command it runs.

stills.name: encryption-03-settings-on-unconfirmed
stills.alt: Settings card with encryption on and no confirmed recovery bundle
stills.caption: A managed key exists and the missing-bundle notice stays until a person confirms a bundle is stored.

stills.name: encryption-04-export-bundle
stills.caption: Download arms only after the tick, and nothing is rendered on screen. The fixture holds no key.

stills.name: encryption-05-bundle-confirmed
stills.alt: Settings card with the recovery bundle confirmed
stills.caption: Confirmation is a statement with a time, and the notice is gone.

stills.name: encryption-06-external-reference
stills.alt: External key reference dialog with a failed test
stills.caption: One single-line reference, three sources, and a three-answer test (resolves, declared but unreachable, not declared).

stills.name: encryption-07-rotate-confirm
stills.caption: Rotation makes a new active key and keeps the old one readable for the copies that record it.

stills.name: encryption-08-rotated
stills.alt: Managed keys table after a rotation
stills.caption: The previous key is superseded, not gone, and the new one is not yet confirmed.

stills.name: encryption-09-retire-refused
stills.caption: A key that active copies still record cannot be retired, and the refusal says how many copies need it.

stills.name: encryption-10-key-missing-settings
stills.alt: Settings card when a required key does not resolve
stills.caption: Drawn as itself: copies are refused, nothing is deleted.

stills.name: encryption-11-key-missing-dashboard
stills.alt: Dashboard health row when a required key does not resolve
stills.caption: The same condition on the dashboard, so it is not found only by opening Settings.

stills.name: encryption-12-set-inherit
stills.caption: Inherit says what it resolves to from the deployment setting.

stills.name: encryption-13-set-required
stills.caption: An explicit Required is distinguishable from Inherit.

stills.name: encryption-14-set-required-key-missing
stills.caption: The set is drawn as refusing and says nothing was deleted.

stills.name: encryption-15-copies-chips
stills.alt: Copies table with a plaintext and an encrypted copy
stills.caption: A plaintext local copy and an encrypted off-site copy that is not decrypt-verified, side by side.

stills.name: encryption-16-copies-key-missing
stills.alt: Copies table with a key-missing copy
stills.caption: A copy whose key does not resolve is Key missing and offers no verify action.

stills.name: encryption-17-verify-dialog
stills.caption: Names the egress cost, needs the acceptance, and echoes the equivalent command.

stills.name: encryption-18-verify-running
stills.caption: Accepted, key resolved, decrypt-verifying. Named progress stages are an undecided contract, so none are drawn.

stills.name: encryption-19-verified-recoverable
stills.alt: Encrypted and Verified recoverable chips on one copy
stills.caption: The two indicators side by side, visibly different.
stills.reason: No mock scenario reaches a copy that is encrypted, whose key resolves and whose placement holds a content-class verification, so the Verified recoverable chip is never drawn. Needs a mock scenario (for example encryption-verified) in ui/shared/src/encryption/mockEncryption.ts.

stills.name: encryption-20-verify-matched
stills.alt: Verify recoverable ended in a match
stills.caption: The plaintext digest equals the catalog's, the copy is Verified recoverable.
stills.reason: The mock's decrypt-verify operation id is unknown to getAssuranceOperation, so the record never ends. Needs a mock operation record that passes.

stills.name: encryption-21-verify-failed
stills.caption: Decrypt failed, no partial plaintext written, recover from another copy.
stills.reason: Same cause as verify-matched: the mock cannot end the operation as failed.
